guidance.summary: Targeting reaching $2 billion in revenue by end of FY27.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: We remain committed to our goal of reaching 2 billion dollars by end of FY27.

guidance.summary: Expecting effective tax rate between 22.5% and 23.5% for the year.
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
guidance.quote: We expect our overall effective tax rate for the year to remain in the range of 22.5% to 23.5% going forward.

guidance.summary: Targeting trading margin improvement of 200 to 300 basis points by FY27.
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
guidance.quote: We have mentioned in the past that it needs to be improved by 200 -300 basis point by the time we reach FY27.

guidance.summary: Requiring 19% to 20% CAGR to achieve $2 billion revenue goal.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: We need a compounded annual growth rate in the range of 19 %-20%.

guidance.summary: Targeting Europe to account for 15% of revenue in 2-3 years.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: or if we get a good scalable acquisition in geographies like Europe, where we have clearly said that we want to be 15% in revenue terms as we go ahead in the next 2-3 years, we'll look at that.
